notes: 2964 of 2975 unique retail address/extent pairs passed strict comparison in 2980 calibration cases using authentic VC6 SP3 (Windows, native CL.EXE). Every relocation was resolved, or the function had no relocation bytes. The remaining 11 match only with relocations masked or are registered near misses: BaseObject::Release, seven UI compiler-shape probes, two FollowRacer near misses (0x4a9d20, 0x4a9e80) and the GridNode near miss 0x484d70. This excludes the physics runner, whose historical exact label masks relocations, and is not a census of retail functions. RTTI/source-path and .text figures were regenerated from the hash-pinned executable.
